contracts.name: QuantumAccount
contracts.description: WASM-signed demo account using SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s.

contracts.name: QuantumAccountFactory
contracts.description: Deploys and registers the QuantumAccounts accepted by QuantumGuard.

contracts.name: SLH-DSA verifier
contracts.description: Onchain verification of 7,856-byte post-quantum signatures.

contracts.name: QuantumGuardHook
contracts.description: Accepts factory-created accounts through the pinned Universal Router. No volume or daily limits.

contracts.name: Uniswap v4 PoolManager
contracts.description: Singleton holding the guarded USDC/WETH pool.

contracts.name: Uniswap Universal Router
contracts.description: Trusted router used by the sponsored swap.

contracts.name: Permit2
contracts.description: Token approvals for Universal Router; compiled separately with Solidity 0.8.17.

contracts.name: Uniswap v4 PositionManager
contracts.description: Manages the funded demo liquidity position.

contracts.name: Uniswap v4 Quoter
contracts.description: Deployed v4 quoter. The guarded pool rejects its callback path; quote through the registered account and router.

contracts.name: Uniswap v4 StateView
contracts.description: Read-only access to PoolManager state.

contracts.name: Demo USDC
contracts.description: Test token with 6 decimals; no monetary value.

contracts.name: Wrapped ETH
contracts.description: Solmate WETH with 18 decimals; IWETH9-compatible.

contracts.name: Hook CREATE2 deployer
contracts.description: Deploys the hook at an address with the required v4 permission bits.

contracts.name: Staking registry
contracts.description: Genesis predeploy holding alternative-mempool stakes.

contracts.name: Demo sponsor
contracts.description: Test-funded sponsor paying gas for the demo account.

contracts.name: Devnet ENSv2 root registry
contracts.description: Official ENSv2 PermissionedRegistry for the devnet root; points eth at the .eth registry.

contracts.name: Devnet ENSv2 .eth registry
contracts.description: Official PermissionedRegistry for .eth; points qsw at the qsw.eth registry. Devnet only, not public .eth.

contracts.name: qsw.eth registry
contracts.description: Official PermissionedRegistry holding qsw.eth subnames as ERC-1155 tokens owned by account vaults.

contracts.name: qsw.eth registrar
contracts.description: Fixed-price registrar from the ENSv2 tutorial pattern: 5 dUSDC per year, at least one year.

contracts.name: ENSVaultFactory
contracts.description: One ENSVault per factory-created QuantumAccount: the vault holds its names, the account controls the vault.

contracts.name: Devnet ENSv2 UniversalResolverV2
contracts.description: Official resolution entry point: resolves qsw.eth names through the registry tree.

contracts.name: PermissionedResolver implementation
contracts.description: Implementation behind each vault's own resolver proxy.

contracts.name: VerifiableFactory
contracts.description: Deploys the vaults' resolver proxies.

contracts.name: Devnet ENSv2 LabelStore
contracts.description: Stores registered labels for the devnet ENSv2 registries.

contracts.name: Devnet ENSv2 ContractNamer
contracts.description: UUPS proxy of the official ContractNamer used by the registries and resolvers.

abiProvenance: Published deployment artifacts; source verification is not provided by this explorer.
